content:
Here are the growing conditions for Nodding Flower Campion (Silene pendula):

• **Temperature:** 15-20°C
• **Hydrometry:** 60-70%
• **Sunshine:** 4-6 hours
• **Rainfall:** 600-800mm
• **Humidity:** 50-60%
• **Soil:** Sandy loam
• **Climate:** Mediterranean temperate
• **Water:** Moderate drainage
• **Location:** Southern Europe
